title: Conductor Agent Card
description: Identity manifest for an externally callable conductor agent. Only agents flagged external_callable in skills/agent-interop/references/agent-registry.yaml may have a card. Internal-only agents must NOT have cards; the gateway refuses to mint them. The card schema is intentionally minimal — three user-named functional fields (auth_scope, allowed_callers, data_classification_clearance) plus identity essentials. Deferred fields (rate_limits, sla_tier, expires_at, revoked, revocation_reason, model_tier, avg_duration_seconds, trust_level, cryptographic signing) are intentionally out of scope per the spec-drift correction and will be reconsidered in a follow-up enhancement.

card_version.description: Semver of the card itself (not the agent). Accepts 'MAJOR.MINOR' or 'MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH'.

agent_id.description: Matches agents/{name}.md filename and registry.id (e.g., conductor-ciso).

name.description: Human-friendly display name for the agent.

auth_scope.description: Auth-tier required to invoke this agent. public=no auth; authenticated=any valid API key; trusted=trust_level>=3; restricted=trust_level>=4.

allowed_callers.description: Caller types permitted to invoke this agent. local=in-process conductor; c2_remote=remote cmux/control plane; telegram_bot=Telegram bridge; n8n_workflows=n8n automation. Caller types not in this list are denied at the gateway.

data_classification_clearance.description: Maximum data classification this agent is cleared to process. Caller's request classification must be <= this clearance for the request to proceed.

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this card revision was issued. Also serves as the anchor for the 30-day card_missing transition window when the gateway is first deployed.

card_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical form of the card (all fields except card_hash itself, sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace). Computed and verified by the gateway at load time. On first authoring, set this field to the placeholder string 'PENDING_FIRST_BUILD'; the gateway computes the real hash and rewrites the file on first load. Used for tamper detection only — NOT a cryptographic signature.
